inductive Code (Symbol Guard : Type) : Type → Type 1 where
  | pure (value : Result) : Code Symbol Guard Result
  | work (job : Work Symbol Guard Result) : Code Symbol Guard Result
  | select (inputs : List (Value Symbol Guard)) : Code Symbol Guard (List (Value Symbol Guard))
  | request (input : Value Symbol Guard) : Code Symbol Guard (Value Symbol Guard)
  | bind (first : Code Symbol Guard First) (next : First → Code Symbol Guard Result) : Code Symbol Guard Result

/-- Ordered traversal threads both the physical heap and the result table between children. -/

def body [DecidableEq Symbol] (top : Guard) (input : Value Symbol Guard) : Code Symbol Guard (Value Symbol Guard) :=
  match input with
  | .node _ edges _ free => if free = [] then root top (MergedSourceGrouping.groups edges) else .pure input
  | _ => .pure input

mutual

inductive Call [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (clear : Guard → Bool) (top : Guard) :
      Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Memo Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard →
        State Symbol Guard → Memo Symbol Guard → Prop where
    | hit (found : memo input.referenceOf = some entry) :
        Call clear top input before memo entry.result before memo
    | miss (absent : memo input.referenceOf = none)
        (actual : Run clear top (body top input) before memo candidate after current) :
        Call clear top input before memo (winner current input candidate).result after (remember current input candidate)
end

/-- Completion retains every previously stored original and result. -/

def remember (memo : Memo Symbol Guard) (input output : Value Symbol Guard) : Memo Symbol Guard :=
  keepFirst memo input.referenceOf ⟨input, output⟩

def execute [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
      (clear : Guard → Bool) (top : Guard) : Nat → Nat → Code Symbol Guard Output →
        State Symbol Guard → Memo Symbol Guard → Outcome Symbol Guard Output
    | 0, _, _, heap, memo => .failed .exhausted heap memo
    | remaining + 1, selectionFuel, code, heap, memo =>
        match code with
        | .pure value => .done value heap memo
        | .work job =>
            let actual := run job heap
            .done actual.1 actual.2 memo
        | .select inputs =>
            match SourceMergedSelection.select clear selectionFuel inputs heap with
            | .done values after => .done values after memo
            | .failed fault after => .failed fault after memo
        | .request input => call clear top remaining selectionFuel input heap memo
        | .bind first next =>
            (execute clear top remaining selectionFuel first heap memo).bind fun value after saved =>
              execute clear top remaining selectionFuel (next value) after saved

def call [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
      (clear : Guard → Bool) (top : Guard) : Nat → Nat → Value Symbol Guard →
        State Symbol Guard → Memo Symbol Guard → Outcome Symbol Guard (Value Symbol Guard)
    | 0, _, _, heap, memo => .failed .exhausted heap memo
    | remaining + 1, selectionFuel, input, heap, memo =>
        match memo input.referenceOf with
        | some entry => .done entry.result heap memo
        | none =>
            (execute clear top remaining selectionFuel (body top input) heap memo).bind fun candidate after current =>
              .done (winner current input candidate).result after (remember current input candidate)
end

def StableCall [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (clear : Guard → Bool) (top : Guard) (input : Value Symbol Guard)
    (before : State Symbol Guard) (memo : Memo Symbol Guard) (output : Value Symbol Guard)
    (after : State Symbol Guard) (saved : Memo Symbol Guard) : Prop :=
  ∃ workBound selectionBound, ∀ workFuel selectionFuel, workBound ≤ workFuel → selectionBound ≤ selectionFuel →
    call clear top workFuel selectionFuel input before memo = .done output after saved

private theorem complete [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    {clear : Guard → Bool} {top : Guard} :
    (∀ {Output} (code : Code Symbol Guard Output) before memo output after saved, Run clear top code before memo output after saved →
      StableRun clear top code before memo output after saved) ∧
    (∀ (input : Value Symbol Guard) before memo output after saved, Call clear top input before memo output after saved →
      StableCall clear top input before memo output after saved) := by
  have pureCase : ∀ {Output} (value : Output) (state : State Symbol Guard) (memo : Memo Symbol Guard),
      StableRun clear top (.pure value) state memo value state memo := by
    intro Output value state memo
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    intro workFuel selectionFuel workEnough _
    cases workFuel with
    | zero => omega
    | succ => rfl
  have workCase : ∀ {Output} (job : Work Symbol Guard Output) state memo,
      StableRun clear top (.work job) state memo (run job state).1 (run job state).2 memo := by
    intro Output job state memo
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    intro workFuel selectionFuel workEnough _
    cases workFuel with
    | zero => omega
    | succ => rfl
  have selectCase : ∀ fuel (inputs : List (Value Symbol Guard)) before values after memo,
      SourceMergedSelection.select clear fuel inputs before = .done values after →
      StableRun clear top (.select inputs) before memo values after memo := by
    intro fuel inputs before values after memo actual
    refine ⟨1, fuel, ?_⟩
    intro workFuel selectionFuel workEnough selectionEnough
    cases workFuel with
    | zero => omega
    | succ => simp only [execute, selection_stable clear fuel selectionFuel inputs before values after actual selectionEnough]
  have requestCase : ∀ (input : Value Symbol Guard) before memo output after saved,
      Call clear top input before memo output after saved → StableCall clear top input before memo output after saved →
      StableRun clear top (.request input) before memo output after saved := by
    intro input before memo output after saved _ stable
    obtain ⟨work, selection, done⟩ := stable
    refine ⟨work + 1, selection, ?_⟩
    intro workFuel selectionFuel workEnough selectionEnough
    cases workFuel with
    | zero => omega
    | succ remaining => exact done remaining selectionFuel (by omega) selectionEnough
  have bindCase : ∀ {Input Output : Type} (first : Code Symbol Guard Input) (next : Input → Code Symbol Guard Output)
      before memo (value : Input) middle current (output : Output) after saved,
      Run clear top first before memo value middle current → Run clear top (next value) middle current output after saved →
      StableRun clear top first before memo value middle current → StableRun clear top (next value) middle current output after saved →
      StableRun clear top (.bind first next) before memo output after saved := by
    intro Input Output first next before memo value middle current output after saved _ _ firstStable laterStable
    obtain ⟨firstWork, firstSelection, firstDone⟩ := firstStable
    obtain ⟨laterWork, laterSelection, laterDone⟩ := laterStable
    refine ⟨max firstWork laterWork + 1, max firstSelection laterSelection, ?_⟩
    intro workFuel selectionFuel workEnough selectionEnough
    cases workFuel with
    | zero => omega
    | succ remaining =>
        simp only [execute, firstDone remaining selectionFuel (by omega) (by omega), Outcome.bind]
        exact laterDone remaining selectionFuel (by omega) (by omega)
  have hitCase : ∀ (input : Value Symbol Guard) before memo entry, memo input.referenceOf = some entry →
      StableCall clear top input before memo entry.result before memo := by
    intro input before memo entry found
    refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
    intro workFuel selectionFuel workEnough _
    cases workFuel with
    | zero => omega
    | succ => exact call_hit _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ found
  have missCase : ∀ (input : Value Symbol Guard) before memo candidate after current,
      memo input.referenceOf = none → Run clear top (body top input) before memo candidate after current →
      StableRun clear top (body top input) before memo candidate after current →
      StableCall clear top input before memo (winner current input candidate).result after (remember current input candidate) := by
    intro input before memo candidate after current absent _ stable
    obtain ⟨work, selection, done⟩ := stable
    refine ⟨work + 1, selection, ?_⟩
    intro workFuel selectionFuel workEnough selectionEnough
    cases workFuel with
    | zero => omega
    | succ remaining => simp only [call, absent, done remaining selectionFuel (by omega) selectionEnough, Outcome.bind]
  constructor
  · intro Output code before memo output after saved actual
    exact Run.rec
      (motive_1 := fun {_} code before memo output after saved _ => StableRun clear top code before memo output after saved)
      (motive_2 := fun input before memo output after saved _ => StableCall clear top input before memo output after saved)
      pureCase workCase
      (by intros; apply selectCase; assumption)
      (by intros; apply requestCase <;> assumption)
      (by intros; apply bindCase <;> assumption)
      (by intros; apply hitCase; assumption)
      (by intros; apply missCase <;> assumption) actual
  · intro input before memo output after saved actual
    exact Call.rec
      (motive_1 := fun {_} code before memo output after saved _ => StableRun clear top code before memo output after saved)
      (motive_2 := fun input before memo output after saved _ => StableCall clear top input before memo output after saved)
      pureCase workCase
      (by intros; apply selectCase; assumption)
      (by intros; apply requestCase <;> assumption)
      (by intros; apply bindCase <;> assumption)
      (by intros; apply hitCase; assumption)
      (by intros; apply missCase <;> assumption) actual

theorem call_complete (clear : Guard → Bool) (top : Guard) (input : Value Symbol Guard)
    (before : State Symbol Guard) (memo : Memo Symbol Guard)
    (semantic : SemanticReady before) (costs : CostHeap before) (stored : Stored before memo) (available : Available before input) :
    ∃ result after saved, Call clear top input before memo result after saved ∧
      Effect before after ∧ Stored after saved ∧ Available after result ∧ (input.free = [] → result.free = []) := by

def Stored (heap : State Symbol Guard) (memo : Memo Symbol Guard) : Prop :=
  ∀ key entry, memo key = some entry → entry.original.referenceOf = key ∧
    Available heap entry.original ∧ Available heap entry.result ∧
      (entry.original.free = [] → entry.result.free = [])

theorem hit_original [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    {heap : State Symbol Guard} {memo : Memo Symbol Guard} {input : Value Symbol Guard} {entry : Entry Symbol Guard}
    (semantic : SemanticReady heap) (available : Available heap input) (stored : Stored heap memo)
    (found : memo input.referenceOf = some entry) :
    entry.original = input ∧ Available heap entry.result ∧ (input.free = [] → entry.result.free = []) := by

    (stored : InternedValueMassHeap.Stored bound heap)
    (input candidate : Value Symbol Guard) (available : Available heap candidate) :

def height : Value Symbol Guard → Nat
  | .node _ edges _ _ => edgesHeight edges + 1
  | _ => 0

theorem child_lt (entry : Interned InternedBinderProtocol.NodeKey)
    (edges : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard)) (depth : Nat) (free : List InternedBinderProtocol.Reference)
    (edge : EdgeValue Symbol Guard) (present : edge ∈ edges)
    (child : Value Symbol Guard) (member : child ∈ edge.children) :
    height child < height (.node entry edges depth free) := by

theorem ordinaryUnion_bound [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (values : List (Value Symbol Guard)) (state : State Symbol Guard)
    (coherent : Coherent state) (linked : Linked state)
    (resident : ∀ value ∈ values, Resident state value) (bound : Nat)
    (bounded : ∀ value ∈ values, height value ≤ bound) :
    height (run (ordinaryUnion values) state).1 ≤ bound := by

theorem column_union_lt [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (entry : Interned InternedBinderProtocol.NodeKey) (edges : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard))
    (depth : Nat) (free : List InternedBinderProtocol.Reference)
    (values : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (selected : ∀ value ∈ values, ∃ edge ∈ edges, value ∈ edge.children)
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (coherent : Coherent state) (linked : Linked state)
    (resident : ∀ value ∈ values, Resident state value) :
    height (run (ordinaryUnion values) state).1 < height (.node entry edges depth free) := by

theorem select_complete (clear : Guard → Bool) (inputs : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (before : State Symbol Guard) (mass : Nat) (semantic : SemanticReady before)
    (stored : InternedValueMassHeap.Stored mass before) (available : Values before inputs) (closed : ClosedValues inputs) :
    ∃ result after,
      select clear (comparisonFuel before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass) inputs before = .done result after ∧
      Effect before after ∧ SourceCurrentAllocatedUnfoldHistory.Fits (heapBound before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass) after ∧
      SourceMergedComparisonMass.Resources
        (SourceMergedSelectionMass.selectionBound (comparisonFuel before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass) inputs.length mass) before after ∧
      ∀ extra, select clear (comparisonFuel before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass + extra) inputs before = .done result after := by

def comparisonFuel (nodes edges mass : Nat) : Nat :=
  let bound := heapBound nodes edges mass
  1 + bound * bound + readerFuel nodes edges mass

variable [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]

theorem check_complete [DecidableEq Symbol] (clear : Guard → Bool) (before : State Symbol Guard)
    (mass : Nat) (semantic : SemanticReady before) (stored : InternedValueMassHeap.Stored mass before)
    (above : List (Nat × Nat)) (wide narrow : Value Symbol Guard)
    (wideInput : Available before wide) (narrowInput : Available before narrow)
    (wideClosed : wide.free = []) (narrowClosed : narrow.free = []) :
    ∃ answer after,
      check clear (comparisonFuel before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass) above wide narrow before = .done answer after ∧
      Effect before after ∧
      SourceCurrentAllocatedUnfoldHistory.Fits (heapBound before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass) after ∧
      SourceMergedComparisonMass.Resources
        (SourceMergedComparisonMass.comparisonBound (comparisonFuel before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass) mass) before after ∧
      ∀ extra, check clear (comparisonFuel before.nodes.next before.edges.next mass + extra)
        above wide narrow before = .done answer after := by

theorem edge [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (symbol : Symbol) (guard : Guard)
    (children : List (Value Symbol Guard)) (state : State Symbol Guard) (stored : Stored bound state) :
    Stored (max bound (1 + InternedValueMass.values children)) (run (makeEdge symbol guard children) state).2 ∧
      InternedValueMass.edge (run (makeEdge symbol guard children) state).1 ≤
        max bound (1 + InternedValueMass.values children) := by

theorem node [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (rows : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard))
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (stored : Stored bound state) :
    Stored (max bound (1 + InternedValueMass.edges rows)) (run (makeNode rows) state).2 ∧
      InternedValueMass.value (run (makeNode rows) state).1 ≤ max bound (1 + InternedValueMass.edges rows) := by

theorem union [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (nodes : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (stored : Stored bound state) :
    Stored (max bound (1 + InternedValueMass.values nodes)) (run (makeUnion nodes) state).2 ∧
      InternedValueMass.value (run (makeUnion nodes) state).1 ≤ max bound (1 + InternedValueMass.values nodes) := by

def nodeBudget : Syntax Symbol Guard → Nat
  | .empty | .var _ => 0
  | .node rows => rowNodes rows + 1
  | .union values => manyNodes values + 1
  | .binder _ body => 3 * nodeBudget body + 4
termination_by expression => sizeOf expression

def edgeBudget : Syntax Symbol Guard → Nat
  | .empty | .var _ => 0
  | .node rows => rowEdges rows
  | .union values => manyEdges values
  | .binder _ body => 3 * edgeBudget body
termination_by expression => sizeOf expression

theorem build_bound (expression : Syntax Symbol Guard) (environment : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (state : State Symbol Guard) :
    (build expression environment state).state.nodes.next ≤ state.nodes.next + nodeBudget expression ∧
      (build expression environment state).state.edges.next ≤ state.edges.next + edgeBudget expression := by

theorem bound [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (key : Nat × Nat) (body : Value Symbol Guard)
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (facts : Facts state) (available : Available state body) :
    (maybeMu key body state).state.nodes.next ≤ state.nodes.next + nodeBudget key body ∧
    (maybeMu key body state).state.edges.next ≤ state.edges.next + edgeBudget key body := by

structure Receipt [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (formulas : SourceGuards.Formulas FullSyntax.Formula) (solver : SourceGuards.Entailment FullSyntax.Formula)
    (inventory : Inventory) (path : List Int) (values : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (before : Checked width) (memo : Memo) (output : Value Symbol Guard) (after : Checked width)
    (saved : Memo) (memos final : Memos) : Prop where
  actual : ∃ projected middle current,
    SourceCurrentConjunctionTargetProjection.Receipt formulas solver inventory path values before projected middle memos current ∧
    SourceCurrentAllocatedMerge.Receipt formulas solver inventory SourceCurrentAllocatedMerge.literalClear
      projected middle memo output after saved current final
  ready : Ready after
  admitted : At formulas solver inventory after
  effects : SourceCurrentConjunctionRowsAllocation.Effects (physical before) (physical after)
  stored : Stored after.native.machine.heap saved
  covered : ∀ ambient, CacheCovers (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient saved
  available : Available after.native.machine.heap output
  closed : output.free = []
  originals : Values after.native.machine.heap values
  nodes : after.native.nodes = before.native.nodes
  edges : after.native.edges = before.native.edges
  domains : after.native.machine.domains = before.native.machine.domains
  retained : Extends memo saved
  globals : Valid after.native.machine.heap final
  unfolding : Extends memos.unfolding final.unfolding
  query : final.query = memos.query
  included : path ≠ [] → ∀ ambient symbol terms part,
    All₂ (meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient) values terms →
    SymbolicSignedPaths.lookup (.node symbol terms) path = some part →
    meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient output part
  root_covered : path = [] → ∀ ambient term,
    (∃ value ∈ values, meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient value term) →
    meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient output term

structure State (Symbol Guard : Type) where
  edges : Cache.State (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)
  nodes : Cache.State NodeKey
  edgeRecords : Table (EdgeKey Symbol Guard) (EdgeValue Symbol Guard)
  nodeRecords : Table NodeKey (Value Symbol Guard)

/-- Both source cache families and both record maps start empty. -/

inductive Work (Symbol Guard : Type) : Type → Type 1 where
  | pure (value : Result) : Work Symbol Guard Result
  | edge (key : EdgeKey Symbol Guard) (identify : Interned (EdgeKey Symbol Guard) → EdgeValue Symbol Guard)
      (next : EdgeValue Symbol Guard → Work Symbol Guard Result) : Work Symbol Guard Result
  | node (key : NodeKey) (identify : Interned NodeKey → Value Symbol Guard)
      (next : Value Symbol Guard → Work Symbol Guard Result) : Work Symbol Guard Result

/-- Preserve both cache effects when sequencing generated templates. -/

def run [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (work : Work Symbol Guard Result) (state : State Symbol Guard) :
    Result × State Symbol Guard :=
  match work with
  | .pure value => (value, state)
  | .edge key identify resume =>
      let result := edgeStep key identify state
      run (resume result.1) result.2
  | .node key identify resume =>
      let result := nodeStep key identify state
      run (resume result.1) result.2

def makeUnion (values : List (Value Symbol Guard)) : Work Symbol Guard (Value Symbol Guard) :=
  match distinctNodes (values.flatMap unionMembers) with
  | [] => .pure .empty
  | [value] => .pure value
  | members =>
      match ordinaryEdges members with
      | some edges => makeNode edges
      | none => .node (.union (members.map Value.referenceOf))
          (fun entry => .union entry members (maximumDepth members) (childFree members)) Work.pure

mutual

theorem run_next_le (work : Work Symbol Guard Result) (state : State Symbol Guard) :
    (run work state).2.nodes.next ≤ state.nodes.next + nodeRequests (observe work state) ∧
    (run work state).2.edges.next ≤ state.edges.next + edgeRequests (observe work state) := by

theorem makeEdge_next (symbol : Symbol) (guard : Guard) (children : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (state : State Symbol Guard) :
    (run (makeEdge symbol guard children) state).2.nodes.next = state.nodes.next ∧
    (run (makeEdge symbol guard children) state).2.edges.next ≤ state.edges.next + 1 := by

theorem makeNode_next (edges : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard)) (state : State Symbol Guard) :
    (run (makeNode edges) state).2.nodes.next ≤ state.nodes.next + 1 ∧
    (run (makeNode edges) state).2.edges.next = state.edges.next := by

theorem intern_next (state : Cache.State Key) (key : Key) :
    (Cache.intern state key).2.next = state.next + (if (state.table key).isNone then 1 else 0) := by
